name: Garden in the Sky
overview: Cherie Chung Chor-hung, Jacky Cheung Hok-yau and David Attenborough narrate this series as we delve into the work of the ecologists and educators of Hong Kong’s 60-year old NGO, Kadoorie Farm and Botanic Garden, revealing work sustainable living, nature conservation and education work in Hong Kong and South China. .Examining the work of the ecologists, gardeners and educators of Hong Kong’s 60-year-old Kadoorie Farm and Botanic Garden, including a behind-the-scenes view of sustainable living, nature conservation and education work in Hong Kong and South China.
